MappingPage                                      baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
|-- MappingPocPage(services) -> MappingWorkspacePage
|   |-- supplied DiagramService / CanvasHistoryService / optional WorkspaceStorage
|   |-- activeId / mountedDocuments / transfers[] / pendingTransfer
|   `-- useAgentCanvasBridge                 commands use workspace controllers
|
|-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace               owns session lifetimes
|   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|   |   |-- metadata                        name / revisionId / busy / hidden
|   |   |-- saved baseline                  savedName / savedScene / savedEdges
|   |   |-- viewport? / representationId?
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController -> [A]
|   |       |-- readable stores             immutable controller references
|   |       |   |-- document                MappingGridDocument
|   |       |   |-- presentation            display / diagramViews
|   |       |   |-- selection / controls
|   |       |   `-- geometry / status       dirty flags; canUndo / canRedo
|   |       `-- onCommit                    checkpoint change -> persistence
|   |-- controllers[documentId]             references to session.controller
|   `-- setDrafts()                         create/subscribe; dispose replaced sessions
|
|-- [A] MappingDocumentController            coordinates document and canvas edits
|   |-- diagrams: DiagramService            sole diagram content writer
|   |   `-- create / revise / generate      return DiagramRevisionResult
|   |       `-- diagram / revision / nodeIds correspondence
|   |-- context: CanvasEditingContext       runtime handle; never saved
|   |   `-- CanvasHistoryService            owns history behind the handle
|   |       |-- WeakMap<context, CanvasHistory>
|   |       `-- append / navigate / resolve / fork / persistenceChanges
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)   shared command path
|   |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
|   |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version / canUndo / canRedo
|   |   |-- cell? / endpointBounds?         rendering measurements
|   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
|   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox           recursive placement tree; cell units
|   |   |   |   |   |-- common              id / position / collapsed / minimumSize?
|   |   |   |   |   |-- kind: diagram       contentId -> contents
|   |   |   |   |   `-- kind: container     children[] / push-right layout / gap
|   |   |   |   `-- contents[id]: Diagram
|   |   |   |       |-- diagramId / revisionId / id / revision
|   |   |   |       |-- content: DiagramContent
|   |   |   |       |   |-- revisionId / ascii / asciiSha256
|   |   |   |       |   `-- structure       diagram | tree
|   |   |   |       |       `-- tree        parserVersion / rootIds / nodes
|   |   |   |       |-- sourceContext       binding? / contentHash / mappings / evidence
|   |   |   |       `-- jumps?
|   |   |   `-- edges[] / sections / jumps?
|   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
|   |       |-- selection.items[]          membership and insertion order
|   |       |   `-- id / displayNodeId / region?
|   |       |       `-- region              captured source / rect / selectedIds
|   |       |-- diagramViews?              per-diagram presentation
|   |       |-- display: DisplayState      floating pane ownership tree
|   |       |   |-- rootIds / nodes[id]: FloatingPane
|   |       |   |-- common                 childIds / expansion / geometryPolicy
|   |       |   |                          position / bounds / coordinateSpace
|   |       |   |-- selection              captured region / child display mode
|   |       |   |-- projection             title / content
|   |       |   |   `-- content variants   call-tree | compaction | source-code | code-panel
|   |       |   |-- conversation           thread / draft / presentation / canvasAnchor
|   |       |   `-- detail                 title / ascii / sectionId?
|   |       `-- controls                   activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
|   |           `-- surfaces[id]           action, prompt and ask UI state
|   `-- canvasDisplayNodes(...): CanvasDisplayNode[]
|       |-- derived read model             geometry stays in the source stores
|       |-- common                         id / version / childIds / expansion
|       |                                  collapsible.self / collapsible.subtrees
|       |-- grid                           diagram | group; cell bounds
|       |   `-- diagram                    content / contentNodes / diagram
|       |-- floating panes                 pixel geometry / placement / value
|       |   `-- placement                  grid-region | parent | conversation | stored
|       `-- floating arrows                drawn from document.edges; connection placement
|
|-- viewState: SourcePaneViewState          live scroll and camera state
|   |-- entries[documentId][paneId] / cameras[documentId]
|   `-- captureDisplay / captureCamera     sample live state for persistence and export
|
|-- persistence: WorkspacePersistence      incremental record translation
|   |-- workspace.onPersist(ids)            changed drafts and committed sessions
|   |-- viewState.subscribe(id)             display scroll / viewport changes
|   |-- cursors[session]                   persistenceChanges(cursor) -> history delta
|   `-- storage.records.batch(changes)      metadata / baseline / history / canvas
|                                          viewport / workspace index
|-- storage: WorkspaceStorage              supplied or created by the page
|   |-- records: RecordStorage              cache / pending changes / in-flight batch
|   |   `-- batch -> flush -> transport.write -> acknowledged revision
|   `-- worker                             one per opened workspace; load/write/project
|
|-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot    explicit full snapshot
|   |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId / transfers[]
|   `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
|       |-- representationId / savedRepresentationId? / name / hidden?
|       |-- revisionId / savedName / savedScene / savedEdges?
|       |-- history                        controller.exportHistory()
|       |-- document                       controller snapshot document
|       |-- canvas                         snapshot + captured display scroll
|       `-- viewport                       captured camera
|-- export                                 serializeWorkspace(capture()) -> JSON
|-- restore(snapshot)                      rebuild drafts/sessions; reset viewState
`-- copy/move across canvases              prepare both histories + transfer transaction
    `-- persist together, then install     workspace undo/redo coordinates participants
